summary: No maintenance obligation is established. The new array and object print depth checks match the parser’s depth checks, so they do not block printing of trees produced by the old harness. Coverage remains incomplete because the delegated build recipe and parsed-item provenance are missing.

claims.necessity_reason: The harness prints only a tree returned by the parser. Array and object parsing both reject a container at the same nesting threshold that the new array print check uses.

before.requirement: Printing a parser-produced array must not fail solely because of its nesting depth.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing rejects a container at the nesting limit.
Object parsing uses the same limit, including for mixed nesting.

after.requirement: Printing a parser-produced array must not fail solely because of its nesting depth.
after.reason: The new check rejects array nesting only at the threshold already rejected during parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing rejects a container at the nesting limit.
Object parsing uses the same limit, including for mixed nesting.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions satisfy the same depth requirement for arrays obtained through the harness’s parse call.

claims.necessity_reason: The new object print check uses the same nesting threshold as array and object parsing, while the harness passes only a parser-returned tree to printing.

before.requirement: Printing a parser-produced object must not fail solely because of its nesting depth.
before.reason: The old object printer has no depth rejection.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing rejects a container at the nesting limit.
Array parsing uses the same limit, including for mixed nesting.

after.requirement: Printing a parser-produced object must not fail solely because of its nesting depth.
after.reason: The new check rejects object nesting only at the threshold already rejected during parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing rejects a container at the nesting limit.
Array parsing uses the same limit, including for mixed nesting.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions satisfy the same depth requirement for objects obtained through the harness’s parse call.

claims.necessity_reason: The printer supports a Raw value, including through array and object child printing. The packet does not establish whether constructing such a child is a supported setup within this read target’s operational surface, or whether parsing can produce one.

before.requirement: If Raw children are within this target’s supported print inputs, a valid input and setup must reach printing of a Raw child.
before.reason: The harness prints only the parser result, but the omitted parse dispatch and Raw construction contract are decisive for scope and reachability.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing delegates each child to the Raw-capable value printer.
Object printing delegates each child to the Raw-capable value printer.

after.requirement: If Raw children are within this target’s supported print inputs, a valid input and setup must reach printing of a Raw child.
after.reason: The Raw print contract and parser-only harness setup remain, but the omitted dispatch and construction contract still prevent a reachability conclusion.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing delegates each child to the Raw-capable value printer.
